title: My New Bike
lines: Last week, I got a new bike.
It is blue and has a small bell.
I ride it in the park with my dad.
Sometimes, my best friend rides with me.
We race around the park for fun.
I feel happy when the wind touches my face.
My new bike is my favorite gift.

title: The Funny Monkey
lines: A little monkey lives in the zoo.
He likes to climb and swing from trees.
One day, he took a man's red hat.
The man looked up and started to laugh.
The monkey wore the hat on his head.
He jumped from one tree to another.
Everyone thought he looked very funny.

title: A Rainy Afternoon
lines: It was raining all afternoon.
I could not go outside to play.
So, I made a fort with chairs and blankets.
I took some books and snacks inside.
My little sister wanted to join me.
We told stories and played fun games.
Soon, my rainy day became lots of fun.

title: The School Pet
lines: Our class has a small pet hamster.
His name is Coco, and he is very active.
Every morning, we give him food and water.
Coco loves to run on his little wheel.
Sometimes, he hides under the soft paper.
We watch him and laugh at his funny moves.
We all enjoy taking care of him.

title: The Surprise Box
lines: Lucy found a box under her bed.
She did not know what was inside.
The box was old and covered in dust.
When she opened it, she found a small toy.
The toy could sing and dance by itself.
Lucy called her brother to come and see.
She was surprised and very excited.

title: A Trip to the Farm
lines: Last Sunday, we visited a farm.
We saw cows, pigs, chickens, and horses.
I gave some food to a hungry goat.
The goat followed me around the farm.
My sister laughed and took many pictures.
We also learned how farmers care for animals.
It was my favorite part of the day.

title: The Big Snowman
lines: It was cold and snowy outside.
Tom and his sister made a big snowman.
They used a carrot for his nose.
They found two small stones for his eyes.
Then, they gave him an old black hat.
Tom put a long scarf around his neck.
Their snowman looked funny and friendly.

title: My Secret Place
lines: There is a small tree behind my house.
I like to sit under it and read books.
Sometimes, I take my dog with me.
The leaves move softly in the wind.
I can hear birds singing in the tree.
It is quiet, cool, and peaceful there.
I think it is my favorite secret place.

title: The Lost Ball
lines: Ben was playing soccer in his yard.
Suddenly, his ball went over the fence.
He looked everywhere, but he could not find it.
He asked his neighbor if she had seen it.
Then, she smiled and gave him the ball.
Ben thanked her and felt very happy.
Soon, he started to play again.

title: A Day at the Beach
lines: My family went to the beach on Saturday.
We played in the water and built sandcastles.
My brother found a beautiful shell.
I collected small rocks near the water.
Later, we ate sandwiches under a big umbrella.
We watched the waves and enjoyed the warm sun.
We went home when the sun started to set.

title: The Little Robot
lines: Sam got a robot for his birthday.
The robot could walk and move its arms.
It also made funny sounds when it danced.
Sam showed the robot to all his friends.
They gave the robot simple commands to follow.
Sometimes, the robot moved in a silly way.
Everyone wanted to play with it.

title: The Magic Pencil
lines: Anna found a strange pencil at school.
It was old, but it had a bright blue color.
Everything she drew became real for one hour.
She drew a cake and shared it with her friends.
Then, she drew a small puppy to play with.
The puppy ran around the classroom and barked.
Anna knew she had found a magic pencil.

title: The Soccer Game
lines: Our class had a soccer game on Friday.
Both teams played very well.
At first, the score was zero to zero.
Everyone tried hard to kick the ball.
Then, Maria kicked the ball into the goal.
Our team cheered and celebrated together.
It was an exciting game for everyone.

title: The Friendly Dragon
lines: A small dragon lived near a green hill.
He was different because he was very kind.
Instead of making people afraid, he helped them.
He carried heavy things for the old people.
He also protected lost animals in the forest.
Soon, people started to visit him every day.
Everyone loved the friendly dragon.

title: The Birthday Surprise
lines: Today is my birthday, but I feel sad.
I think everyone forgot about my special day.
When I get home, the lights are off.
I walk slowly into the living room.
Suddenly, everyone jumps out and says, “Surprise!”
There is a big cake and many colorful balloons.
I smile because my family planned a party for me.
